faq.question: How much does window replacement cost in Woodside?
faq.answer: Woodside homeowners typically invest $25,000 to $80,000+ for window replacement projects. This extraordinary Peninsula community — home to tech billionaires and Silicon Valley legends — features custom estate homes with 30–50+ windows, large-format glass walls, and bronze-clad custom frames. Projects using Marvin Ultimate or bespoke Western Window Systems installations can exceed $100,000.

faq.question: Do I need a permit to replace windows in Woodside?
faq.answer: Yes. Woodside requires a building permit for all window replacements. The Town's Planning Department reviews projects for consistency with Woodside's rural, equestrian character. Large-format glass installations may require additional architectural drawings and a Site Design Review. Our team manages all permit applications and design review submittals on your behalf.

faq.question: Is it worth replacing 20-year-old windows in Woodside?
faq.answer: Often yes. Twenty-year-old windows in Woodside commonly show fogged glass, drafts and weak locks. Newer ENERGY STAR units improve comfort and curb appeal; Deluxe Windows compares payback against your utility rates and home style before recommending replacement.

faq.question: Should I choose fiberglass or vinyl windows in Woodside?
faq.answer: Vinyl is the value pick for most Woodside replacements and handles Bay Area weather well. Fiberglass (including Marvin Ultrex) is stronger, more stable in temperature swings and better for larger openings or coastal exposure. We show both side by side in the showroom and on-site.

faq.question: How long does window replacement take in Woodside?
faq.answer: Most Woodside projects are measured in one visit and installed in one to three working days once products arrive — typically four to eight weeks after ordering, depending on brand and custom sizes.
